impact: More pressure on NVDA ahead of its Nov 17 report; a prolonged leadership vacuum would weigh on the AI chip chain including MU, DRAM and SNXX, and on NBIS sentiment.
summary: Bernstein's Stacy Rasgon downgraded Nvidia to Market Perform from Outperform and cut the price target to $200 from $400, citing leadership uncertainty rather than demand. It is the third broker in two days to step back, after Baird cut to Neutral ($200 from $500) and Morgan Stanley stepped back on Nov 11. The New York Times also reported Huang had a relationship with Nvidia's VP of healthcare, Kimberly Powell, as the board weighs his future.
title: Bernstein cuts Nvidia to Market Perform, halves target to $200
